tooltips.photonAddressCountryCodes:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, e.g. ch, de, at.

Leave empty to use the preferred countries from Administration → Address Countries. If no countries are preferred there either, the fallback ch, de, at applies.
tooltips.photonAddressUrl: Leave empty for the public instance https://photon.komoot.io/api/ (no SLA). For production use, point this to a self-hosted Photon instance.
tooltips.photonAddressLang: Two-letter language code for result labels, e.g. de, en, fr. Default: de.
tooltips.photonAddressBiasZoom: OSM zoom level the location bias applies at (1–18). 12 ≈ city scale; lower values widen the preferred area (10 ≈ region), higher values narrow it. Only takes effect when address sub-fields (city, postal code) are already filled. Default: 12.
tooltips.photonAddressBiasScale: How strongly the context location influences the ranking (0–1). 0 disables the bias; Photon's own default is 0.2. Default: 0.4.
